title: Shift M and Command Shift M jump between markers on a video
goal: Editors drop markers with M while they watch and then hop between them to cut. On a video, Shift M should move the playhead to the next marker and Command Shift M to the previous one, as in Premiere. Today markers can be made and dragged but not reached from the keyboard, and Shift M quietly changes the canvas selection tool instead.
notes: Timeline keys: Sources/PhotonzCore/TimelineKeys.swift (M -> .addMarker at :201); carried out in Sources/Photonz/EditorState+TimelineKeys.swift; menu rows in Sources/Photonz/EditorCommands.swift. Shift M today is the invisible selection-cycle button in EditorView.swift:3141. Plain letters act on the timeline only while it has the keyboard, so the same gate settles the Shift M conflict: timeline first on a video, Photoshop's cycle elsewhere (memory: Photoshop shortcut parity). Premiere: Shift M next marker, Command Shift M previous marker. Found by the 2026-10-05 evening manager pass's key audit; Up/Down already jump between edit points.
acceptance: With the timeline holding the keyboard (as it does straight after a recording opens), Shift M puts the playhead on the next marker and Command Shift M on the previous one; at the last or first marker nothing moves
Sequence (or wherever Add Marker lives in the menu bar) gains Go to Next Marker and Go to Previous Marker rows carrying those keys, dimmed when there is no marker that way
On a still image Shift M still cycles the selection tools, as Photoshop does
A walk at Next defaults drops three markers, presses Shift M and Command Shift M, and reads the playhead after each; it runs green
Try it: open a recording, press M at three moments, Home, then Shift M three times. Audit written under queue/audits/
anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

Adversarial pass: Premiere editors expect Shift M / Cmd Shift M; the conflict is Photoshop's Shift M selection cycle, settled by the timeline-keyboard gate like M/I/O. Cmd Shift M has no other meaning so it works wherever the keyboard is (the file's rule for keys no tool wants). At the first/last marker the press is still swallowed so Shift M never falls through to the selection cycle.

left rough (no task, below the bar): ruler right-click menu has no Go to Next/Previous Marker rows, since every row there acts at the clicked moment; raised as an evaluate question in the audit instead.

Shift M (timeline has the keyboard) and Cmd Shift M (anywhere on a video) go to the next / previous marker; Sequence has Go to Next/Previous Marker rows with those keys, dimmed when nothing lies that way. Still images keep Shift M's selection cycle.
